Our Story

The Maker started in 2019 with a simple passion for baking and creating good pastries. Located in the heart of George Town, Penang, we are surrounded by the city’s vibrant streets and favourite destinations.
 

What started as a small baking journey has grown into a place where we continue to make handcrafted pastries with care, using quality ingredients and staying true to what we love — baking.
